description: 0.005 USDC per call via x402, no key (unpaid call returns PaymentRequired; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Record an x402 payment the agent made (or update a reserved one by spendId/ref): status settled|failed|pending|refunded, tx; verify:true checks a Base tx on-chain (read-only). Builds the spend log / receipts. Needs a key mts_ (X-API-Key header or apiKey argument). No key? call settle_trial_key (free, 50 calls/7 days). Full plan 1 USDC/30d incl. 1,000 calls via x402.

amountUsd.description: USD amount as decimal string, e.g. "0.25".

apiKey.description: Your MoneyTools Settle key mts_… (alternative to the X-API-Key header). No key: call settle_trial_key.

paymentRequired.description: The 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64) or the 402 JSON body.

spendId.description: Spend id sp_… from spend_check reserve.

tx.description: Settlement tx hash on Base, 0x + 64 hex.
